description: We are seeking a highly skilled and compassionate Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a dedicated nursing leader to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development. The ideal candidate will be passionate about delivering high-quality healthcare services and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and promoting best practices in patient care. This role offers a competitive annual salary of $85,000 - $95,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment. Join a team that values excellence and provides a rewarding environment for professional growth.
requirements: Valid Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing
Experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 based on experience.
